name: Elys Swift
source:
Elys Swift is the owner of the Curiosity Shop, a narrow little place tucked away on a street that seems to appear only when you are looking for something you cannot name. A devoted member of the Cult of Tenebrous, she trades in rare artifacts, strange books, and the kind of trinkets that have stories clinging to them like dust. Her wares are carefully chosen, each one with a purpose that may not be clear until much later, if ever.

[From the in-game profile]
